Caught and fixed during standalone testing before wiring into the page: (1) naive ordering let '\right' stripping eat the 'right' out of '\rightarrow', leaving literal 'arrow' text on the page; (2) plain-text HTML-escaping was being re-applied to already-generated <sup>/fraction HTML, double-escaping it - fixed by routing all generated markup through placeholder tokens, substituted back in only after the surrounding plain text is escaped. One real bug found and fixed upstream, not papered over here: pipeline/serialize.py's 'answer' flow never stripped render_item()'s own baked-in '**Label:** ' markdown prefix (mdio.py's markdown_to_chapter() already does this on its own read path; serialize.py had no equivalent) - every boxed final-answer echo was showing literal '**उत्तर:** 30%' text. Added _strip_answer_flow_prefix() to serialize.py (mirroring mdio.py's own _strip_answer_prefix), re-ran stage 8, confirmed the JSON's answer fields are now clean plain text - this fixes every future chapter's stage 9 build too, not just this one.
